name: chromadb_vector_query
description: Run semantic-similarity (nearest-neighbour) searches against a local, on-disk Chroma vector database. Query by a raw embedding vector or by natural-language text, with optional metadata and document-content filters, and receive structured matches with documents, metadata, and distances.

persist_directory.description: Path to the on-disk Chroma database directory (created by chromadb.PersistentClient)

collection_name.description: Name of the Chroma collection to query

query_text.description: Natural-language query. Requires the collection to have an embedding function (Chroma's default downloads a model on first use)

query_embedding.description: Raw query vector (list of floats). Takes precedence over query_text and requires no embedding model

n_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 5)

returns.description: Query result containing status, collection, query_type, matches (id, document, metadata, distance), match_count, and execution_time_ms
